title: One real user
purpose: Measure one number, watch a real person use it, fix what breaks, measure again.
why: Deployment, not demos. A stranger using what you built, in their actual environment, is the evidence nothing else can fake.
evidence: Who used it, what broke, what changed.

tasks.title: Measure one number before they use it (time, errors, steps)

fields.label: The number and how you measured it

tasks.title: Sit with them while they use it; fix what breaks
tasks.done_when: Notes on what broke and what you fixed.

tasks.title: Measure the same number after
tasks.done_when: Before and after, side by side.
